name: 59072 · Roundup, MT
findings: ZIP 59072 (Roundup) has 26 nonprofit organizations. 7 of them (27%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 7 organizations.
Youth organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (29% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 59072 (Roundup) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 5 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.

confidence.text: Based on 5 organizations here; 35% of all organizations here have no identified type.
